From: Alex Kim <alex@oxide.dev>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting a demo for GitHub integration (OSS use)

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for a self-serve trial this morning and are evaluating Redwood for powering a code-summarization feature in our OSS tooling. I saw the demo flow and would like to schedule a short walkthrough for product + engineering. A couple quick questions before we lock a time: 1) what webhook scopes does the GitHub App need for basic repo discovery and PR events? 2) We run GitHub Enterprise behind a firewall — does Redwood support a tech pre-call to go over installation options?

I'm cc'ing my engineering lead Samira. We're flexible but would prefer US mornings (PST). Looking forward to a quick sync.

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Head of Developer Relations
Oxide Labs
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@oxide.dev>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Samira Noor <samira@oxide.dev>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting a demo for GitHub integration (OSS use)

Hi Alex — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood!

Happy to get a demo on the calendar. Quick answers: webhook scopes for the demo/standard integration are typically repo, pull_request, and issues (we can run with read-only at first). For GHE behind firewall, we absolutely do a technical pre-call to review installation patterns and proxy options — Monica (cc) handles the GHE installs and will join the call.

Here are two 30m windows for next week in PST:
- Tue Apr 18, 9:30–10:00am PST
- Wed Apr 19, 11:00–11:30am PST

If those don't work, pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/jordan/30m. Monica — can you also attach a short pre-call checklist for GHE installs?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Kim <alex@oxide.dev>

Cc: Samira Noor <samira@oxide.dev>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Thanks Jordan — Tue 9:30am PST works for Samira and me. A couple more details to help Monica prepare:
- We want to keep the GitHub App installation as read-only where possible, but need PR payloads and branch metadata. Will that require additional scopes?
- Our GHE has a proxy and we may need to open outbound to a specific endpoint/IPs. If you have a checklist we can share with ops, that'd be great.

I'll mark Tue Apr 18 9:30am on our side — please send an invite.

Cheers,
Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex@oxide.dev>, Samira Noor <samira@oxide.dev>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting a demo for GitHub integration (OSS use)

Hi Alex / Samira — thanks, looking forward to the call. Short answers inline:
- For PR payloads + branch metadata, the app needs pull_request and repo scopes; most customers keep organization-level scopes minimal and grant repo-level access to the specific repos the integration targets.
- For GHE behind a proxy, we provide two install patterns: 1) a hosted webhook relay (outbound from your GHE to a relay URL) or 2) an on-prem proxy appliance. We'll walk through both on the pre-call.

I've attached: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf (high level network/IPs and required endpoints) and sample-app-manifest.yaml (example scopes and install manifest). Please share the checklist with your ops team.

Tue Apr 18 9:30am PST is on my calendar, but Jordan flagged a potential conflict on his side and asked to confirm. If you prefer, I can run the tech pre-call solo and Jordan can join for the demo — let me know.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-precall-checklist.pdf, sample-app-manifest.yaml
